name: Shree Rajasthan Syntex Limited
about: Shree Rajasthan Syntex Limited engages in the production of textile products in India. The company offers fiber dyed yarns, such as polyester-viscose, acrylic, 100% polyester, 100% viscose, and regenerated 100% polyester; raw white yarns, including Micro Danier SOFT/SUPERSOFT, low shrinkage automotive, and slub/flame 100% polyester/PV blends; cotton yarn consisting of Karded Cotton; and polypropylene multifilament color yarns comprising bulk continuous filament, and fully drawn and partially oriented yarns. It also engages in the generation of power from coal. The company also exports its products. Its products are used in various applications, such as suiting, shirting, sportswear, furnishing, upholstery, towel, knit, blanket, velvet, chenille, seating, technical, and lamination. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Dungarpur, India.
